mechanics.definition: 通过一次或多次Pick、Wheel或等价抽取，从密封奖励池中得到奖励结果，并按固定次数或停止条件结束。

conditional_packages.when: entry_source_semantics至少声明一个endogenous游戏内生入口来源；只有一个内生来源时保留退化支持不适用实例，两个及以上时评分

evidence_signatures: each draw index and resolved outcome are observable
the reward pool, replacement or dependency rule and stop condition reproduce the complete feature award
exclusions: a deterministic menu only chooses a game mode
true skill changes the mathematical outcome outside the declared reward pool
a visible wheel is only an animation for an already settled ordinary win
